fields.System.Title: TRF-1 — Transfer orders
fields.System.Description:
Purpose

Record an intention to move stock between warehouses, and let both sites see it.

Scope

In. Creating transfers, validating origin stock, status visibility, cancellation before
dispatch.

Out. Deciding what should transfer — that is network planning, a separate discipline.

Design notes

Cancellation is only legal before dispatch. Once stock is in transit it is physically on a
lorry, and no database update changes that. A transfer that needs reversing after dispatch is a
new transfer in the opposite direction.

Both sites see the same record. In a single-instance deployment this is trivial. It is
worth building the status query as if the two sites might one day be separate databases,
because that is the direction this epic points.

Store all timestamps in UTC. Two sites in different timezones with local timestamps produce
event orderings where the receipt appears to precede the dispatch.

Risks

| Risk | Reference |
|---|---|
| Transfer cancelled after dispatch | [doc 05 WF 12](../../../docs/05-workflows.md) |
| Timezone differences producing nonsensical ordering | [doc 09 §9.4](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
| Origin stock unavailable by the time picking starts | [doc 09 §4.5](../../../docs/09-defect-hotspots.md) |
